visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular, shirtless man wearing a black baseball cap and white earbuds runs along a city sidewalk next to a busy road with traffic. The sky is overcast and the lighting is dim, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. He looks into the camera, sweating and breathing heavily, with residential buildings in the background. (2) A second man wearing a teal-colored t-shirt joins the shirtless runner. They are now moving through a park area with paved stone walkways, benches, and dense green trees. The camera is handheld and shaky, following their movement as they smile and gesture towards each other. (3) The environment shifts to an outdoor plaza at night with bright artificial lighting. The men stop running, and the first man holds up his arm to show a smartwatch with a yellow band, which displays fitness tracking data. They are both smiling and looking energized. (4) The final scene is set indoors in a living room area. Both men are shirtless, sitting cross-legged behind a low table piled with a variety of fried foods, including chicken and potatoes. They look directly at the camera, posing with wide smiles and thumbs-up gestures, clearly celebrating their post-run meal.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: PEETA 百人約跑. [Subtitle]: 現在已經跑了兩公里多了. 我的跑友還沒來. 這算雷跑嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: (終於來了) 約跑約跑. 你最近對跑步有什麼目標嗎? 最大的一個目標就是我年底的臺北馬. 跑贏你. (3) [Subtitle]: 確定捏. 那我這樣也要報了喔. [Variety]: Man Against Horse. 跟馬比賽跑步. [Subtitle]: 不是, 欸, 我邀你10月那個然後你就不報. (4) [Subtitle]: 那個離你的舒適圈太遠. (笑而不語). 你找Eric. [Variety]: 居然推給隊友. (5) [Subtitle]: 好啦你把Eric的Line給我. 可以沒有問題. [Variety]: 十月美國見! (6) [Subtitle]: 欸 Eric 我們LA見. 我有發覺跑步其實是蠻好玩的. 只是我的身體 有點太重. 你那麼壯. (7) [Slogan]: Ian跑全馬的速度 3小時30分的速度. (8) [Subtitle]: 差不多就這樣 還好吧對不對. [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈. (9) [Subtitle]: 結束 耶. 總共6.6K 如何. 要不要回家吃飯. 吃飯 餓了. 回家吃吃. (10) [Variety]: 真的回家吃吃了! (食完筆記本Ian篇即將上線)

(2) Two male voices engage in a rapid, friendly dialogue with high vocal arousal and breathiness from physical exertion. The acoustic guitar BGM continues at a steady volume. A 'ding' SFX marks a transition as they discuss marathon training goals. (3) The vocal tones become highly excited with frequent bursts of laughter. The ambient noise floor shifts to softer rustling of leaves and wind. A 'cartoonish' sound effect is used to emphasize a joke about a competition. (4) The audio texture shifts completely to an indoor environment with a distinct room tone. The voices are no longer breathy. The sound of plastic rustling and a light thud of a container being placed on a table are heard before the audio ends.
